lastResponse.text: This is an emergency. Call nine one one right now. The number is 9, 1, 1. Tell them: “Adult male, pills and alcohol, not waking up, gray lips, barely breathing.” Put the phone on speaker, keep him flat, and start hard, fast chest compressions now until EMS takes over. I’m staying with you while you call.
